meta.name: replay-user-flows
meta.description: Turn a user journey you just clicked through into a saved regression check that re-runs deterministically, with no model in the loop and no test code to write. Use when you have driven the same flow twice, when the user wants regression coverage without a Playwright suite, when a refactor needs proving against every existing journey, or when re-verifying by hand is costing a full drive every time.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把刚走过的页面流程存成自动回归检查,不用写测试代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完代码都要手动把关键流程重走一遍
copy.tagline_en: Save a flow you just clicked through as a replayable regression check
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you re-drive the same key flows by hand after every change

howto.what: 你点过一遍的用户流程会在会话结束时自动存成 .reticle/flows/ 下的回归检查,之后可确定性重放,不需要模型参与,也不用写测试代码。重放有三种结果:ok、drift、error,失败会指出源码位置。
howto.when: 当同一个流程你已经走过两遍、想要不带 Playwright 套件的回归覆盖、重构后要验证已有流程,或人工复核每次都要重跑一遍时触发。

say.text: 把这个流程存成回归检查,以后改动时重放它
say.note: 流程会自动存到 .reticle/flows/ 并可提交

say.text: 只重放覆盖 src/tasks/TaskList.tsx 改动的那些流程
say.note: 按改动范围挑选流程,不跑整批

say.text: 跑一遍全部已保存的流程,只告诉我失败的

howto.what_en: Journeys you click through are saved to .reticle/flows/ when the session ends, then replayed with no model in the loop and no test code. Replays return ok, drift, or error, with failures pointing at source.
howto.when_en: Use when you have driven the same flow twice, want regression coverage without a Playwright suite, need a refactor proved against existing journeys, or re-verifying by hand costs a full drive each time.

say_en.text: Save this flow as a regression check and replay it after changes
say_en.note: The flow lands in .reticle/flows/ and can be committed

say_en.text: Replay only the flows covering my edit to src/tasks/TaskList.tsx
say_en.note: Picks flows by edited files instead of the whole suite

say_en.text: Run every saved flow and show me only the failures
